import math

int number(string text)
    return int(text)

int floor_div(int numerator, int denominator)
    return if numerator >= 0 then numerator / denominator else -((-numerator + denominator - 1) / denominator)

string decimal(int numerator, int denominator, int places)
    scale := 10 ^ places
    scaled := numerator * scale / denominator
    fraction := string(scaled % scale)
    return string(scaled / scale) + "." + "0" * nat(places - int(#fraction)) + fraction

string money(int amount)
    return decimal(amount, 100, 2)

string ratio(int numerator, int denominator)
    return if denominator == 0 then "n/a" else decimal(numerator, denominator, 4)

string aligned(string text, int width)
    return " " * nat(math.max(0, width - int(#text))) + text

string listed(const int[] values, string separator)
    pieces := [for value := values[] then string(value)]
    return pieces.join(separator)

void emit(string text)
    println(text)

string[] stage_names()
    return ["RETAILER", "WHOLESALER", "DISTRIBUTOR", "FACTORY"]

int | error stage_index(string name)
    names := stage_names()
    for: 0 <= index < 4
        if names[index] == name
            return index
    return error("unknown stage " + name)

class Policy(string name, int[] parameters, string notation)

Policy | error parse_policy(const string[] words)
    name := words[0]
    int count
    if name == "PASS"
        count = 0
    elif name == "FIXED" or name == "BASESTOCK"
        count = 1
    elif name == "MINMAX" or name == "MOVAVG" or name == "SMOOTH"
        count = 2
    elif name == "STERMAN"
        count = 4
    else
        return error("unknown policy " + name)
    if int(#words) != count + 1
        return error("{name} needs {count} parameters")
    int[] parameters := []
    for: 0 <= index < count
        text := words[index + 1]
        if name == "STERMAN" and index < 3
            parts := text.split(".")
            parameters = parameters.append(100 * number(parts[0]) + number(parts[1]))
        else
            parameters = parameters.append(number(text))
    valid := true
    if name == "FIXED"
        valid = parameters[0] <= 1000
    elif name == "BASESTOCK"
        valid = parameters[0] <= 10000
    elif name == "MINMAX"
        valid = parameters[0] < parameters[1] and parameters[1] <= 10000
    elif name == "MOVAVG" or name == "SMOOTH"
        valid = 1 <= parameters[0] <= (if name == "MOVAVG" then 52 else 10) and parameters[1] <= 10000
    elif name == "STERMAN"
        valid = parameters[0] <= 100 and parameters[1] <= 100 and parameters[2] <= 100 and parameters[3] <= 10000
    if not valid
        return error("invalid parameter for " + name)
    return Policy(name, parameters, words.join(" "))

class Settings(int inventory, int quantity, int shipping_delay, int order_delay, int holding_rate, int backlog_rate, Policy policy)
class Record(int received, int incoming, int shipped, int previous_backlog, int ontime, int inventory, int backlog, int order, int holding, int owing, int cost)
class PlantRecord(int incoming, int made, int backlog)
class Stage(Settings initial)
    int inventory := initial.inventory
    backlog := 0
    int[] shipping := array(nat(initial.shipping_delay), fill = initial.quantity)
    int[] pending := array(nat(initial.order_delay), fill = initial.quantity)
    Policy policy := initial.policy
    int expected := 100 * initial.quantity
    int holding_rate := initial.holding_rate
    int backlog_rate := initial.backlog_rate
    lot := 1
    capacity := -1
    Record[] records := []

class Simulation(Stage[] stages, int[] demand)
    week := 0
    plant_backlog := 0
    plant_capacity := -1
    visible := false
    PlantRecord[] plant_records := []

class Game(Settings[] initial, int[] base, Simulation current)
    snapshots := map<string, Simulation>()

Simulation fresh(const Settings[] initial, const int[] demand)
    stages := [for settings := initial[] then Stage(settings)]
    return Simulation(stages, demand)

int supply_line(const Simulation simulation, int index)
    stage := simulation.stages[index]
    upstream := if index == 3 then simulation.plant_backlog else simulation.stages[index + 1].backlog
    return stage.pending.sum() + upstream + stage.shipping.sum()

int signal(const Simulation simulation, int index, int week)
    return if simulation.visible then simulation.demand[week - 1] else simulation.stages[index].records[week - 1].incoming

void assign_policy(Simulation &simulation, int index, const Policy policy)
    simulation.stages[index].policy = policy
    simulation.stages[index].expected = 100 * (if simulation.week == 0 then simulation.stages[index].initial.quantity else signal(simulation, index, simulation.week))

int policy_order(Simulation &simulation, int index, int supply, int position)
    &stage := &simulation.stages[index]
    policy := stage.policy
    parameters := policy.parameters
    week := simulation.week + 1
    incoming := stage.records[week - 1].incoming
    demand_signal := signal(simulation, index, week)
    if policy.name == "FIXED"
        return parameters[0]
    if policy.name == "PASS"
        return incoming
    if policy.name == "BASESTOCK"
        return math.max(0, parameters[0] - position)
    if policy.name == "MINMAX"
        return if position <= parameters[0] then parameters[1] - position else 0
    if policy.name == "MOVAVG"
        count := math.min(parameters[0], week)
        int[] signals := []
        for: week - count + 1 <= int previous <= week
            signals = signals.append(signal(simulation, index, previous))
        forecast := signals.sum() / count
        return math.max(0, parameters[1] + forecast * (stage.initial.shipping_delay + stage.initial.order_delay) - position)
    if policy.name == "SMOOTH"
        return math.max(0, demand_signal + floor_div(parameters[1] - position, parameters[0]))
    stage.expected = floor_div(100 * parameters[0] * demand_signal + (100 - parameters[0]) * stage.expected, 100)
    net := stage.inventory - stage.backlog
    return math.max(0, floor_div(100 * stage.expected + parameters[1] * (100 * (parameters[3] - net) - parameters[2] * supply), 10000))

void advance_week(Simulation &simulation)
    int[] received := []
    for &stage := &simulation.stages[]
        received = received.append(stage.shipping[0])
        stage.inventory += stage.shipping[0]
        stage.shipping = stage.shipping[1:]
    incoming := [simulation.demand[simulation.week]]
    for &stage := &simulation.stages[]
        incoming = incoming.append(stage.pending[0])
        stage.pending = stage.pending[1:]
    for: 0 <= index < 4
        &stage := &simulation.stages[index]
        before := stage.backlog
        requested := before + incoming[index]
        shipped := math.min(stage.inventory, requested)
        if stage.capacity >= 0
            shipped = math.min(shipped, stage.capacity)
        stage.inventory -= shipped
        stage.backlog = requested - shipped
        ontime := math.min(incoming[index], math.max(0, shipped - before))
        stage.records = stage.records.append(Record(received[index], incoming[index], shipped, before, ontime, stage.inventory, stage.backlog, 0, 0, 0, 0))
        if index > 0
            simulation.stages[index - 1].shipping = simulation.stages[index - 1].shipping.append(shipped)
    requested := simulation.plant_backlog + incoming[4]
    produced := if simulation.plant_capacity < 0 then requested else math.min(requested, simulation.plant_capacity)
    simulation.plant_backlog = requested - produced
    simulation.stages[3].shipping = simulation.stages[3].shipping.append(produced)
    simulation.plant_records = simulation.plant_records.append(PlantRecord(incoming[4], produced, simulation.plant_backlog))
    int[] supplies := []
    int[] positions := []
    for: 0 <= index < 4
        supply := supply_line(simulation, index)
        supplies = supplies.append(supply)
        positions = positions.append(simulation.stages[index].inventory + supply - simulation.stages[index].backlog)
    for: 0 <= index < 4
        quantity := policy_order(&simulation, index, supplies[index], positions[index])
        &stage := &simulation.stages[index]
        quantity = (quantity + stage.lot - 1) / stage.lot * stage.lot
        stage.pending = stage.pending.append(quantity)
        &record := &stage.records[simulation.week]
        record.order = quantity
        record.holding = stage.inventory * stage.holding_rate
        record.owing = stage.backlog * stage.backlog_rate
        record.cost = record.holding + record.owing
    simulation.week += 1

int stage_cost(const Stage stage)
    costs := [for record := stage.records[] then record.cost]
    return costs.sum()

int chain_cost(const Simulation simulation)
    costs := [for stage := simulation.stages[] then stage_cost(stage)]
    return costs.sum()

int[] values_for(const Stage stage, string kind)
    return [for record := stage.records[] then (if kind == "ORDERS" then record.order elif kind == "INV" then record.inventory elif kind == "BACK" then record.backlog else record.inventory - record.backlog)]

int variation(const int[] values)
    return int(#values) * (values * values).sum() - values.sum() ^ 2

string fill_rate(const Stage stage)
    incoming := [for record := stage.records[] then record.incoming]
    ontime := [for record := stage.records[] then record.ontime]
    return if incoming.sum() == 0 then "n/a" else decimal(ontime.sum() * 100, incoming.sum(), 2) + "%"

Simulation trial(const Game game, const Policy[] policies)
    result := fresh(game.initial, game.current.demand)
    result.visible = game.current.visible
    result.plant_capacity = game.current.plant_capacity
    for: 0 <= index < 4
        &stage := &result.stages[index]
        current := game.current.stages[index]
        stage.lot = current.lot
        stage.capacity = current.capacity
        stage.holding_rate = current.holding_rate
        stage.backlog_rate = current.backlog_rate
        assign_policy(&result, index, policies[index])
    while result.week < int(#result.demand)
        advance_week(&result)
    return result

class Interval(int first, int last)

Interval | error command_range(const string[] words, int offset, int limit)
    first := if int(#words) > offset then number(words[offset]) else 1
    last := if int(#words) > offset then number(words[offset + 1]) else limit
    if not (1 <= first <= last) or last > limit
        return error("bad range {first} {last}")
    return Interval(first, last)

void demand_notice(const int[] demand)
    emit("DEMAND weeks {#demand} total {demand.sum()} min {demand.min()} max {demand.max()}")

void show_costs(const Simulation simulation)
    emit("COSTS week {simulation.week}")
    int[] holding_totals := []
    int[] backlog_totals := []
    names := stage_names()
    for: 0 <= index < 4
        holding := [for record := simulation.stages[index].records[] then record.holding]
        owing := [for record := simulation.stages[index].records[] then record.owing]
        held := holding.sum()
        owed := owing.sum()
        holding_totals = holding_totals.append(held)
        backlog_totals = backlog_totals.append(owed)
        emit("{names[index]} holding {money(held)} backlog {money(owed)} total {money(held + owed)}")
    emit("TOTAL holding {money(holding_totals.sum())} backlog {money(backlog_totals.sum())} total {money(holding_totals.sum() + backlog_totals.sum())}")

string peak_week(const int[] values, int peak)
    if peak == 0
        return "-"
    for: 0 <= index < int(#values)
        if values[index] == peak
            return string(index + 1)
    return "-"

void show_peaks(const Simulation simulation)
    emit("PEAKS weeks 1-{simulation.week}")
    names := stage_names()
    for: 0 <= index < 4
        inventory := values_for(simulation.stages[index], "INV")
        backlog := values_for(simulation.stages[index], "BACK")
        highest_inventory := inventory.max()
        highest_backlog := backlog.max()
        current_run := 0
        longest := 0
        ending := 0
        for: 0 <= offset < simulation.week
            current_run = if backlog[offset] > 0 then current_run + 1 else 0
            if current_run > longest
                longest = current_run
                ending = offset + 1
        stretch := if longest == 0 then "0" else "{longest} weeks {ending - longest + 1}-{ending}"
        emit("{names[index]} max_inv {highest_inventory} week {peak_week(inventory, highest_inventory)} max_back {highest_backlog} week {peak_week(backlog, highest_backlog)} longest_stockout {stretch}")

void show_leadtime(const Simulation simulation, int index)
    stage := simulation.stages[index]
    nominal := stage.initial.shipping_delay + stage.initial.order_delay
    received := -nominal * stage.initial.quantity
    int[] cumulative := []
    for record := stage.records[]
        received += record.received
        cumulative = cumulative.append(received)
    orders := 0
    ordered := 0
    int[] leads := []
    for: 0 <= offset < simulation.week
        quantity := stage.records[offset].order
        ordered += quantity
        if quantity > 0
            orders += 1
            for: offset + 1 <= arrival < simulation.week
                if cumulative[arrival] >= ordered
                    leads = leads.append(arrival - offset)
                    break
    measures := "min - avg - max -"
    if #leads > 0
        measures = "min {leads.min()} avg {decimal(leads.sum(), int(#leads), 2)} max {leads.max()}"
    names := stage_names()
    emit("LEADTIME {names[index]} nominal {nominal} orders {orders} completed {#leads} open {orders - int(#leads)} {measures}")

class Comparison(Policy policy, int cost, string fill, string bullwhip)

void | error command(Game &game, const string[] words)
    verb := words[0]
    &simulation := &game.current
    names := stage_names()
    horizon := int(#simulation.demand)
    if verb == "DEMAND" or verb == "GENERATE"
        int[] demand := []
        if verb == "DEMAND"
            demand = [for word := words[1:][] then number(word)]
        else
            weeks := number(words[1])
            for: 5 <= offset < int(#words) step 3
                week := number(words[offset + 1])
                if not (1 <= week <= weeks)
                    return error("week {week} outside horizon")
            seed := number(words[4])
            for: 1 <= week <= weeks
                level := number(words[2])
                for: 5 <= offset < int(#words) step 3
                    start := number(words[offset + 1])
                    amount := number(words[offset + 2])
                    if words[offset] == "STEP" and week >= start
                        level += amount
                    elif words[offset] == "PULSE" and week == start
                        level += amount
                    elif words[offset] == "RAMP" and week >= start
                        level += amount * (week - start + 1)
                if level < 0
                    return error("negative level at week {week}")
                seed = seed * 48271 % 2147483647
                demand = demand.append(level + seed % number(words[3]))
        game.base = demand
        simulation = fresh(game.initial, demand)
        demand_notice(demand)
    elif verb == "RESET"
        simulation = fresh(game.initial, game.base)
        emit("RESET week 0")
    elif verb == "SAVE"
        .game.snapshots.set(words[1], simulation)
        emit("SAVE {words[1]} week {simulation.week}")
    elif verb == "LOAD"
        match game.snapshots.get(words[1])
            Simulation saved
                simulation = saved
            none
                return error("no snapshot " + words[1])
        emit("LOAD {words[1]} week {simulation.week}")
    elif verb == "RUN"
        if simulation.week == horizon
            return error("horizon reached at week {horizon}")
        first := simulation.week + 1
        last := math.min(horizon, simulation.week + number(words[1]))
        before := chain_cost(simulation)
        while simulation.week < last
            advance_week(&simulation)
            for: 0 <= index < 4
                record := simulation.stages[index].records[simulation.week - 1]
                if record.previous_backlog == 0 and record.backlog > 0
                    emit("STOCKOUT {names[index]} week {simulation.week} backlog {record.backlog}")
                elif record.previous_backlog > 0 and record.backlog == 0
                    emit("RECOVER {names[index]} week {simulation.week}")
        emit("RUN {first}-{last} demand {simulation.demand[first - 1:<last].sum()} cost {money(chain_cost(simulation) - before)}")
        if simulation.week == horizon
            emit("HORIZON {horizon}")
    elif verb == "SET"
        target := -1
        if words[1] != "ALL"
            target = try stage_index(words[1])
        policy := try parse_policy(words[2:])
        for: 0 <= index < 4
            if target < 0 or target == index
                assign_policy(&simulation, index, policy)
        emit("SET {words[1]} {policy.notation}")
    elif verb == "BATCH" or verb == "COST" or verb == "CAPACITY"
        target := -1
        if verb != "CAPACITY" or words[1] != "PLANT"
            target = try stage_index(words[1])
        if verb == "BATCH"
            lot := number(words[2])
            if not (1 <= lot <= 100)
                return error("invalid batch size " + words[2])
            simulation.stages[target].lot = lot
            emit("BATCH {words[1]} {words[2]}")
        elif verb == "COST"
            holding := number(words[2])
            owing := number(words[3])
            if holding > 1000 or owing > 1000
                return error("invalid cost")
            simulation.stages[target].holding_rate = holding
            simulation.stages[target].backlog_rate = owing
            emit("COST {words[1]} holding {holding} backlog {owing}")
        else
            capacity := if words[2] == "OFF" then -1 else number(words[2])
            if capacity > 10000
                return error("invalid capacity " + words[2])
            if target < 0
                simulation.plant_capacity = capacity
            else
                simulation.stages[target].capacity = capacity
            emit("CAPACITY {words[1]} {words[2]}")
    elif verb == "VISIBILITY"
        if words[1] != "ON" and words[1] != "OFF"
            return error("unknown visibility " + words[1])
        simulation.visible = words[1] == "ON"
        emit("VISIBILITY " + words[1])
    elif verb == "SHOCK"
        week := number(words[1])
        if not (1 <= week <= horizon)
            return error("week {week} outside horizon")
        if week <= simulation.week
            return error("week {week} already simulated")
        before := simulation.demand[week - 1]
        simulation.demand[week - 1] = number(words[2])
        emit("SHOCK week {week} {before} -> {words[2]}")
    elif verb == "STATUS"
        emit("STATUS week {simulation.week} of {horizon}")
        for: 0 <= index < 4
            stage := simulation.stages[index]
            supply := supply_line(simulation, index)
            expectation := if stage.policy.name == "STERMAN" then " expect " + money(stage.expected) else ""
            emit("{names[index]} inv {stage.inventory} back {stage.backlog} transit {listed(stage.shipping, ",")} pending {listed(stage.pending, ",")} supply {supply} position {stage.inventory + supply - stage.backlog} policy {stage.policy.notation}{expectation}")
        emit("PLANT back {simulation.plant_backlog}")
    elif verb == "SETTINGS"
        emit("SETTINGS")
        for: 0 <= index < 4
            stage := simulation.stages[index]
            capacity := if stage.capacity < 0 then "OFF" else string(stage.capacity)
            emit("{names[index]} holding {stage.holding_rate} backlog {stage.backlog_rate} batch {stage.lot} capacity {capacity} delays {stage.initial.shipping_delay} {stage.initial.order_delay}")
        emit("PLANT capacity " + (if simulation.plant_capacity < 0 then "OFF" else string(simulation.plant_capacity)))
        emit("VISIBILITY " + (if simulation.visible then "ON" else "OFF"))
    elif verb == "COSTS"
        show_costs(simulation)
    elif verb == "BALANCE"
        emit("BALANCE week {simulation.week}")
        for: 0 <= index < 4
            stage := simulation.stages[index]
            received := [for record := stage.records[] then record.received]
            shipped := [for record := stage.records[] then record.shipped]
            emit("{names[index]} start {stage.initial.inventory} received {received.sum()} shipped {shipped.sum()} end {stage.inventory} owed {stage.backlog}")
        initial_goods := [for settings := game.initial[] then settings.inventory + settings.quantity * settings.shipping_delay]
        production := [for record := simulation.plant_records[] then record.made]
        delivered := [for record := simulation.stages[0].records[] then record.shipped]
        stocks := [for stage := simulation.stages[] then stage.inventory]
        transit := [for stage := simulation.stages[] then stage.shipping.sum()]
        emit("SYSTEM initial {initial_goods.sum()} produced {production.sum()} delivered {delivered.sum()} stock {stocks.sum()} transit {transit.sum()}")
    elif verb == "DEMANDS"
        interval := try command_range(words, 1, horizon)
        demand := simulation.demand[interval.first - 1:<interval.last]
        emit("DEMANDS {interval.first}-{interval.last} total {demand.sum()} min {demand.min()} max {demand.max()}")
        emit(listed(demand, " "))
    elif verb == "COMPARE"
        Policy[] policies := []
        start := 1
        for: 1 <= offset <= int(#words)
            if offset == int(#words) or words[offset] == "/"
                policy := try parse_policy(words[start:<offset])
                policies = policies.append(policy)
                start = offset + 1
        Comparison[] results := []
        demand_variation := variation(simulation.demand)
        for policy := policies[]
            result := trial(game, array(4, fill = policy))
            row := Comparison(policy, chain_cost(result), fill_rate(result.stages[0]), ratio(variation(values_for(result.stages[3], "ORDERS")), demand_variation))
            results = results.append(row)
            index := int(#results) - 1
            while index > 0 and results[index - 1].cost > row.cost
                results[index] = results[index - 1]
                index -= 1
            results[index] = row
        emit("COMPARE {#policies} weeks {horizon}")
        for: 0 <= index < int(#results)
            row := results[index]
            emit("{index + 1} {row.policy.notation} total {money(row.cost)} fill {row.fill} bullwhip {row.bullwhip}")
    elif verb == "OPTIMIZE"
        target := -1
        if words[1] != "ALL"
            target = try stage_index(words[1])
        low := number(words[2])
        high := number(words[3])
        if low > high
            return error("bad range {low} {high}")
        if high - low > 200
            return error("range too large")
        best_level := low
        best_cost := -1
        best_total := 0
        for: low <= level <= high
            policies := [for stage := simulation.stages[] then stage.policy]
            for: 0 <= index < 4
                if target < 0 or target == index
                    policies[index] = Policy("BASESTOCK", [level], "BASESTOCK {level}")
            result := trial(game, policies)
            total := chain_cost(result)
            objective := if target < 0 then total else stage_cost(result.stages[target])
            if best_cost < 0 or objective < best_cost
                best_level = level
                best_cost = objective
                best_total = total
        emit("OPTIMIZE {words[1]} BASESTOCK {best_level} cost {money(best_cost)} total {money(best_total)}")
    elif verb == "WEEK" or verb == "TABLE" or verb == "CHAIN" or verb == "SUMMARY" or verb == "FILLRATE" or verb == "BULLWHIP" or verb == "PEAKS" or verb == "LEADTIME" or verb == "PLOT" or verb == "HISTOGRAM"
        target := -1
        if verb == "TABLE" or verb == "LEADTIME" or verb == "PLOT" or verb == "HISTOGRAM"
            target = try stage_index(words[1])
        if verb == "PLOT" or verb == "HISTOGRAM"
            if words[2] != "ORDERS" and words[2] != "INV" and words[2] != "BACK" and words[2] != "NET"
                return error("unknown mode " + words[2])
        if verb == "HISTOGRAM" and not (1 <= number(words[3]) <= 100)
            return error("invalid width " + words[3])
        if simulation.week == 0
            return error("no weeks simulated")
        if verb == "WEEK"
            week := number(words[1])
            if not (1 <= week <= simulation.week)
                return error("bad week {week}")
            emit("WEEK {week} demand {simulation.demand[week - 1]}")
            for: 0 <= index < 4
                record := simulation.stages[index].records[week - 1]
                emit("{names[index]} recv {record.received} in {record.incoming} ship {record.shipped} inv {record.inventory} back {record.backlog} order {record.order} cost {money(record.cost)}")
            record := simulation.plant_records[week - 1]
            emit("PLANT in {record.incoming} made {record.made} back {record.backlog}")
        elif verb == "TABLE" or verb == "CHAIN"
            interval := try command_range(words, if verb == "TABLE" then 2 else 1, simulation.week)
            if verb == "TABLE"
                emit("TABLE {words[1]} {interval.first}-{interval.last}")
                emit("week     in   ship   recv    inv   back  order      cost")
            else
                emit("CHAIN {interval.first}-{interval.last}")
                headings := [for name := names[] then aligned(name, 11)]
                emit("week demand " + headings.join(" "))
            for: interval.first <= week <= interval.last
                line := aligned(string(week), 4)
                if verb == "TABLE"
                    record := simulation.stages[target].records[week - 1]
                    columns := [record.incoming, record.shipped, record.received, record.inventory, record.backlog, record.order]
                    for column := columns[]
                        line += " " + aligned(string(column), 6)
                    line += " " + aligned(money(record.cost), 9)
                else
                    line += " " + aligned(string(simulation.demand[week - 1]), 6)
                    for stage := simulation.stages[]
                        line += " " + aligned(string(stage.records[week - 1].order), 11)
                emit(line)
        elif verb == "SUMMARY"
            emit("SUMMARY weeks 1-{simulation.week}")
            for: 0 <= index < 4
                stage := simulation.stages[index]
                inventory := values_for(stage, "INV")
                backlog := values_for(stage, "BACK")
                orders := values_for(stage, "ORDERS")
                zeroes := [for quantity := orders[] if quantity == 0 then quantity]
                emit("{names[index]} avg_inv {decimal(inventory.sum(), simulation.week, 2)} avg_back {decimal(backlog.sum(), simulation.week, 2)} orders {orders.sum()} min {orders.min()} max {orders.max()} zero_weeks {#zeroes}")
        elif verb == "FILLRATE"
            emit("FILLRATE weeks 1-{simulation.week}")
            for: 0 <= index < 4
                stage := simulation.stages[index]
                incoming := [for record := stage.records[] then record.incoming]
                ontime := [for record := stage.records[] then record.ontime]
                stockouts := [for record := stage.records[] if record.backlog > 0 then record]
                count := int(#stockouts)
                emit("{names[index]} fill {fill_rate(stage)} ontime {ontime.sum()} ordered {incoming.sum()} stockout_weeks {count} service {decimal((simulation.week - count) * 100, simulation.week, 2)}%")
        elif verb == "BULLWHIP"
            weeks := simulation.week
            demand := simulation.demand[0:<weeks]
            demand_variation := variation(demand)
            previous := demand_variation
            emit("BULLWHIP weeks 1-{weeks} demand mean {decimal(demand.sum(), weeks, 4)} var {decimal(demand_variation, weeks * weeks, 4)}")
            for: 0 <= index < 4
                orders := values_for(simulation.stages[index], "ORDERS")
                spread := variation(orders)
                emit("{names[index]} mean {decimal(orders.sum(), weeks, 4)} var {decimal(spread, weeks * weeks, 4)} ratio {ratio(spread, demand_variation)} step {ratio(spread, previous)}")
                previous = spread
        elif verb == "PEAKS"
            show_peaks(simulation)
        elif verb == "LEADTIME"
            show_leadtime(simulation, target)
        elif verb == "PLOT"
            interval := try command_range(words, 3, simulation.week)
            values := values_for(simulation.stages[target], words[2])[interval.first - 1:<interval.last]
            highest := values.max()
            lowest := values.min()
            net := words[2] == "NET"
            emit("PLOT {words[1]} {words[2]} {interval.first}-{interval.last} " + (if net then "min {lowest} max {highest}" else "max {highest}"))
            extent := if net then math.max(math.abs(lowest), math.abs(highest)) else highest
            for: 0 <= index < int(#values)
                value := values[index]
                length := if extent == 0 then 0 else math.abs(value) * (if net then 25 else 50) / extent
                line := aligned(string(interval.first + index), 3) + " "
                if net
                    line += " " * nat(if value < 0 then 25 - length else 25)
                    line += (if value < 0 then "-" * nat(length) else "") + "|"
                    line += if value > 0 then "+" * nat(length) else ""
                else
                    line += "|" + "#" * nat(length)
                emit(line + " " + string(value))
        else
            width := number(words[3])
            values := values_for(simulation.stages[target], words[2])
            bins := [for value := values[] then floor_div(value, width)]
            emit("HISTOGRAM {words[1]} {words[2]} width {width} weeks 1-{simulation.week}")
            for: bins.min() <= bin_number <= bins.max()
                matches := [for value := bins[] if value == bin_number then value]
                string bar := if #matches == 0 then "" else " " + "*" * #matches
                emit("{bin_number * width}..{bin_number * width + width - 1} {#matches}{bar}")
    else
        return error("unknown command " + verb)
    return void
